categories.name: Names for India's native street dog

fun_fact: India's street dogs — affectionately called **Indies** — are remarkably adaptive survivors, shaped by thousands of years on the subcontinent. But that resilience has limits: record-breaking heat waves leave them battling **dehydration and heatstroke** with little water or shade. Simple acts — [water bowls, shaded spots and community feeding](https://www.dw.com/en/indias-forgotten-stray-animals-suffer-under-record-heat-waves/a-62233286) — can be the difference between life and death.
author: Divya P
